summary.text: Roxanne Lathan is the Democratic candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 11 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Joanne Shofner.
A retired Nacogdoches school principal, she says she is running on livable wages, public education funding and affordable healthcare.

paragraphs.text: In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Lathan said she was born and raised in East Texas and graduated from Nacogdoches High School.

She said she graduated from the University of Texas at Dallas in 2003, began her education career as an elementary teacher, earned a master's degree from the University of Phoenix four years later, and became a principal.
She said she retired from the Nacogdoches Independent School District in 2025 after 21 years in schools.
Lathan advanced from the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026.
Her survey lists three key messages: livable wages and economic growth, more funding for public education with opposition to vouchers, and affordable health care.
She named holding elected officials accountable as a policy area she is passionate about and listed Blue Texas as an endorser.
